description:
This file defines an Android activity that manages a 3D Rubik's cube visualization using OpenGL. It includes methods for setting up the cube's structure, handling animation layers, and managing user interaction for rotating cube layers.

Key features include: creation of cube components, assignment of colors to cube faces, management of permutations to simulate rotations, and integration with OpenGL rendering pipeline.

classes.name: Kube
classes.description: Android activity that renders and manages an animated 3D Rubik's cube using OpenGL, supporting layer rotations and permutations to simulate cube moves.

methods.name: makeGLWorld
methods.description: Initializes and assembles the 3D world including all cube pieces, colors, and layers.

methods.name: createLayers
methods.description: Creates and configures the different rotation layers of the cube.

methods.name: updateLayers
methods.description: Updates references to cube pieces within each rotation layer based on current permutation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity's view and renderer.

methods.name: animate
methods.description: Performs a step in the animation cycle, including rotating layers and updating permutations to simulate cube moves.
